title: 209. Permutations II

examples.explanation: The three output arrays do not include duplicate permutations: [1,1,2] appears only once.
There are six ways to order three distinct values.

hints: Sort `nums` so equal values are adjacent.
Build the permutation one position at a time, and skip placing `nums[i]` when it equals a value already placed at that same depth in a previous branch.
